_comment: Ratchet for bun run test:audit. Counts normally only go down: lower a number in the same commit that lowers the count. A number may go UP only when the DETECTOR got stricter and started seeing sites that were always there, never to admit new ones — raise it in the same commit as the detector change and record the reason below.
_sourceShape: 36. Down from 52 by fifteen real conversions and one correction, and the 52 was already stale: the tree measured 51 before this branch. THE MISSING ONE WAS NOT FIXED, IT WAS HIDDEN. PR 718 renamed src/hub/ to src/board/, which made `readFileSync(join(__dirname, '..', 'src', 'hub', 'hub-live-wiring.ts'), 'utf8')` in walk-handoff.test.ts too long for the formatter; biome wrapped it, the read call and the path literal landed on different lines, and the per-line form stopped seeing a site that is still there and still grepping source. Three more reads are wrapped the same way today (board-quick-actions.test.ts x2, board-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts), on top of the two the check's own comment already names. So 36 is a ceiling on what the detector CAN see, not a census — a line-length change can lower it without anyone converting anything. What went for real: the six MCP tests that grepped the committed bundle now run it over stdio (packages/mcp/test/harness/mcp-bundle.ts), pushing frames down its event stream and reading the channel line, or calling the tool and reading the POST body — every one of them was verified to go red against a deliberately broken bundle, and three of the six old assertions stayed GREEN under the same mutation. The nine artifact reads in client-release.test.ts and launcher.test.ts carry the new per-site `// audit: not-source — <reason>` marker: neither reads repo source at all (a tmpdir the test just published into, and a manifest that is JSON.parse'd for two fields), and the reason line at each site says what break it catches. What remains: nine MCP tests reading packages/mcp/src through test/harness/mcp-source.ts; twenty-three app tests that read board/*.ts, app.ts, board-live-wiring.ts, doc-meeting-mount.ts and meeting-strip.ts as TEXT and assert on that text — board-app.ts and app.ts have exported bootBoard and bootApp since PR 634, so the honest reason these stay is that nobody has converted them yet; and four stylesheet reads across three files, of which decide-option-hover-css.test.ts (a :hover treatment), board-nav-widget-clearance-css.test.ts (a calc() of max() and env() that happy-dom discards whole) and shell-grid-placement.test.ts (grid auto-placement, which needs a layout engine) are all beyond happy-dom.
